phase_5.degraded_rationale: The rubric's 5.1 exit path is explicit: when no genuinely separate model is reachable, record NONE_AVAILABLE and do not simulate its output. No second LLM score was invented and no agreement metric is reported as if it had been measured. Instead of a simulated peer, a MECHANICAL validator was run: an independent re-implementation of the arithmetic that re-derives every penalty term from the raw severity/confidence/grade triple, re-sums R_point from the published per-dimension scores, re-applies the hard gates, re-runs the Monte Carlo from the published bands and re-opens a seeded 10-token evidence sample by reading the cited file ranges. That checks arithmetic and citation, not judgement, and the gap is stated plainly.
